# Partner2B

> Partner2B helps B2B tech companies build and run partner programs. We recruit, enable and market partners. The site also runs a free directory of B2B partner programs with commission models, tiers and features, taken from public program pages.

## Directory and programs

- [Directory of B2B partner programs](https://partner2b.com/directory): reseller, referral, technology, services, MSP and OEM programs, with links to official pages
- [AI partner programs](https://partner2b.com/ai): partner programs of AI vendors, grouped by category
- [Glossary](https://partner2b.com/glossary): definitions of partner program terms such as MDF, deal registration, partner tiers and co-selling

## Guides and data

- [Blog](https://partner2b.com/post): articles on partner programs, partner marketing, co-selling and ecosystems
- [B2B partner program commission rates in 2026](https://partner2b.com/post/b2b-partner-program-commission-rates): what 622 programs publish about how partners are paid
- [Partner program tiers in 2026: how many and what to name them](https://partner2b.com/post/partner-program-tiers-how-many-and-what-to-name-them): how many tiers 860 programs list and which names they use, with infographics
- [Ecosystem-Led Growth Playbook 2026](https://partner2b.com/playbook): free playbook

## Tools and services

- [Program builder](https://partner2b.com/program-builder): answer a few questions and get a partner program strategy as a PDF
- [Partner pipeline calculator](https://partner2b.com/partner-pipeline-calculator): enter a revenue goal, deal size and sales cycle and see how many partner companies to list and reach out to
- [Partner program assessment](https://partner2b.com/partner-program-assessment): free assessment for a partner program that does not perform: 16 short statements show which two of eight areas hold it back, with benchmarks on partner activation and answers to common questions
- [Services](https://partner2b.com/services): positioning, partner recruitment, enablement, co-marketing and co-selling
